name: [POC] RHEL CVE Approval-Gated Remediation
description: Approval-gated remediation for open, remediable vulnerabilities on the approved RHEL demo host. Datadog discovers and prioritizes all eligible findings, Slack approves one selected finding, AAP applies the approved package remediation, and Datadog verifies host and finding state.

parameters.name: query
parameters.value:
SELECT ts,
  status,
  severity,
  resource_id,
  finding_id,
  resource_name,
  remediation_available,
  cve_id,
  package_name,
  installed_version,
  fixed_version,
  advisory_id,
  runtime_active
FROM dd.security_findings(
  columns => ARRAY[
    'timestamp',
    '@status',
    '@severity',
    '@resource_id',
    '@finding_id',
    '@resource_name',
    '@remediation.is_available',
    '@advisory.cve',
    '@package.name',
    '@package.version',
    '@remediation.package.base.version',
    '@advisory.id',
    '@package.is_running'
  ],
  filter => '@status:open @remediation.is_available:true @advisory.cve:*',
  finding_types => ARRAY['host_and_container_vulnerability']
) AS (
  ts TIMESTAMP,
  status VARCHAR,
  severity VARCHAR,
  resource_id VARCHAR,
  finding_id VARCHAR,
  resource_name VARCHAR,
  remediation_available BOOLEAN,
  cve_id VARCHAR,
  package_name VARCHAR,
  installed_version VARCHAR,
  fixed_version VARCHAR,
  advisory_id VARCHAR,
  runtime_active BOOLEAN
)
WHERE cve_id IS NOT NULL
  AND resource_name = 'rhel09-vuln-poc-01'
LIMIT 100
